```{r}
library(hoopR)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(sportyR)
```

```{r}
shots_2024 <- hoopR::load_nba_stats_shots(
  seasons = 2023
)

shots_2024 |>
  count(season_type_id)
```

```{r}
sum(duplicated(shots_2024))

shots_2024 |>
  count(shot_value)

shots_2024 |>
  filter(duplicated(shots_2024))
```


```{r}
shots_2024 <- shots_2024 |>
  mutate(
    made = if_else(shot_result == "Made", 1, 0)
  )
fg_percentage_2024 <- sum(shots_2024$made)/length(shots_2024$made)
```

```{r}
shots_2024_B <- shots_2024 |>  
  group_by(shot_distance) |> 
  summarise(fg_percentage = sum(made)/length(made), attempts = length(made))

total_attempts_2024 <- sum(shots_2024_B$attempts)


```

```{r}
ggplot(data = shots_2024_B, aes(x = shot_distance, y = fg_percentage)) +
  geom_col()

ggplot(shots_2024_B, aes(x = shot_distance, y = fg_percentage)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) 
  
```

```{r}
shots_2024 <- shots_2024 |> mutate(over_40 = if_else(shot_distance >= 40, 1, 0)) 
shots_2024_B3 <- shots_2024 |> filter(over_40 == 1)

shots_over_40 <- (nrow(shots_2024_B3)/total_attempts_2024)*100


```

```{r}
head(shots_2024$clock, 10)

shots_2024 |>
  filter(shot_distance >= 40) |>
  select(period, clock, shot_distance) |>
  head(15)
```
```{r}
shots_2024 <- shots_2024 |>
  mutate(
    minutes = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+(?=M)")),
    seconds = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=S)")),
    time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
    under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !(shot_distance >= 36 &
      time_remaining <= 3 &
      period <= 3)
  )

shots_2024_C <- shots_2024 |> filter(shot_distance >= 40)

total_attempts_over_40ft <- nrow(shots_2024_C)

shots_2024_D <- shots_2024 |> filter(shot_distance >= 40, under_3s == 1)

total_attempts_under_3s_over_40ft<- nrow(shots_2024_D)

shots_o40ft_u3s <- (total_attempts_under_3s_over_40ft/total_attempts_over_40ft) * 100

shots_o40ft_u3s

```

```{r}
shots_30ft_39ft <- shots_2024 |>
  filter(shot_distance >= 30, shot_distance < 40) |>
  summarise(
    total_attempts = n(),
    under_3_attempts = sum(under_3s),
    percentage = (under_3_attempts / total_attempts) * 100
  )

shots_20ft_29ft <- shots_2024 |>
  filter(shot_distance >= 20, shot_distance < 30) |>
  summarise(
    total_attempts = n(),
    under_3_attempts = sum(under_3s),
    percentage = (under_3_attempts / total_attempts) * 100
  )

```

```{r}
shots_2024_likelhood_under3s <- shots_2024 |>
  group_by(shot_distance) |> 
  summarise(
    total_attempts = n(),
    under_3s_attempts = sum(under_3s),
    percentage = (under_3s_attempts / total_attempts))
 
```

```{r}
ggplot(shots_2024_likelhood_under3s, aes(x=shot_distance, y=percentage)) + 
  geom_smooth() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
shots_2024_subtype <- shots_2024 |> group_by(sub_type) |> summarise(avg_distance = mean(shot_distance)) |> arrange(avg_distance)

shots_2024_subtype
```

```{r}
shots_2024_shot_type_comparison <- shots_2024 |>
  filter(
    sub_type == "Jump Shot" |
    sub_type == "Pullup Jump shot" |
    sub_type == "Step Back Jump shot"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(shots_2024_shot_type_comparison,
       aes(x = sub_type, y = shot_distance)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
shot_comparison_20ft_29ft <- shots_2024_shot_type_comparison |> 
  filter(shot_distance >19, shot_distance <30) |> 
  group_by(sub_type) |> 
  summarise(
    total_attempts = n(),
    made_shots_total = sum(made),
    fg_percentage = made_shots_total/total_attempts
  )
  
```

```{r}
shots_2024 |>
  filter(shot_distance >19, shot_distance <30) |>
  mutate(distance_group = floor(shot_distance / 2) * 2) |>
  group_by(distance_group) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    made = sum(made),
    fg_percentage = made/attempts
  )
```

```{r}
shots_by_distance_and_subtype <- shots_2024 |>
  filter(shot_distance >19, shot_distance <30) |>
  filter(
    sub_type == "Jump Shot" |
    sub_type == "Pullup Jump shot" |
    sub_type == "Step Back Jump shot"
  ) |> 
  mutate(distance_group = floor(shot_distance / 2) * 2) |>
  group_by(distance_group, sub_type) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    made = sum(made),
    fg_percentage = made/attempts
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(shots_by_distance_and_subtype, aes(x = distance_group, y = fg_percentage, color = sub_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
player_shots_value <- shots_2024 |> mutate(total_points = made*shot_value) |> 
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    total_score = sum(total_points),
    points_per_attempt = total_score/attempts,
    field_goals_made = sum(made)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(points_per_attempt)) |> 
  filter(field_goals_made >= 300) |> 
  head(10)
  
```


### Modell 1
```{r}
model_1 <- glm(made ~ shot_distance, data = shots_2024, family = binomial)

summary(model_1)
```

```{r}
shots_2024 <- shots_2024 |>
  mutate(xfg = predict(model_1, type = "response"), xPts = xfg * shot_value)
```

```{r}
player_table <- shots_2024 |>
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    fg_made = sum(made),
    total_points = sum(made * shot_value),
    xPts = sum(xfg * shot_value),
    PAE = total_points - xPts,
    SMP = PAE/attempts
  ) |> 
  filter(fg_made > 299) |> 
  arrange(desc(SMP))

player_table

```

## Model 2

```{r}
model_2 <- glm(made ~ shot_distance + sub_type, data = shots_2024, family = binomial)

summary(model_2)
```

```{r}
anova(model_1, model_2, test = "Chisq")
```

## Training and Testing

```{r}
hoopR::load_nba_stats_shots(seasons = 2024)
```



```{r}
# Load 2024-25 NBA shot data
shots_2025 <- hoopR::load_nba_stats_shots(seasons = 2024) |>
  mutate(
    made = if_else(shot_result == "Made", 1, 0)
  )

# Check dataset size
nrow(shots_2025)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(shots_2025))

# Check shot subtypes
unique(shots_2025$sub_type)

# Identify subtypes not present in training data
setdiff(
  unique(shots_2025$sub_type),
  unique(shots_2024$sub_type)
)
```
```{r}
shots_2025 <- shots_2025 |>
  mutate(
    made = if_else(shot_result == "Made", 1, 0),
    minutes = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+(?=M)")),
    seconds = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=S)")),
    time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
    under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0),
    shot_angle = atan2(abs(x_legacy), y_legacy),
    at_origin = if_else(x_legacy == 0 & y_legacy == 0, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !(shot_distance >= 36 &
      time_remaining <= 3 &
      period <= 3)
  )
```


```{r}
predict(
  object = model_1,
  newdata = shots_2025,
  type = "response"
)
```


```{r}
shots_2025<- shots_2025 |>
  mutate(xfg_model1 = predict(
    object = model_1,
    newdata = shots_2025,
    type = "response"
  ))
```


```{r}
mean((shots_2025$xfg_model1 - shots_2025$made)^2)
```

```{r}
shots_2025 <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(xfg_model2 = predict(
    object = model_2,
    newdata = shots_2025,
    type = "response"
)) 

mean((shots_2025$xfg_model2 - shots_2025$made)^2)
```
## Calibration
```{r}
shots_2025_prob_bins <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(
    probaility_bin = cut(xfg_model2, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |> 
  group_by(probaility_bin) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    fg_made = sum(made),
    fg_percentage = fg_made/attempts,
    xfg_m1 = mean(xfg_model1),
    xfg_m2 = mean(xfg_model2)
  )
```

## Investigate 

```{r}
shots_2025_probability_summary <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(
    probaility_bin = cut(xfg_model2, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE),
    minutes = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+(?=M)")),
    seconds = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=S)")),
    time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
    under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0)
    ) |> 
  group_by(probaility_bin) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    avg_distance = mean(shot_distance),
    median_distance = median(shot_distance),
    avg_time_left = mean(time_remaining),
    pct_under_3s = mean(under_3s),
    min_distance = min(shot_distance),
    max_distance = max(shot_distance)
    )



```


```{r}
shots_2025_probability_summary_30ft_39ft <- shots_2025 |>
  mutate(
    distance_bin = cut(
      shot_distance,
      breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 5),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    minutes = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+(?=M)")),
    seconds = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=S)")),
    time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
    under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(distance_bin, under_3s) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    fg_percentage = mean(made),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
```

### Model 3

```{r}
model_3 <- glm(made ~ shot_distance + sub_type + under_3s, shots_2024, family = binomial)

summary(model_3)
```
```{r}
shots_2025 <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(
    probaility_bin = cut(xfg_model2, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE),
    minutes = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+(?=M)")),
    seconds = as.numeric(str_extract(clock, "\\d+\\.\\d+(?=S)")),
    time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
    under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0)
    )

shots_2025 <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(xfg_model3 = predict(
    object = model_3,
    newdata = shots_2025,
    type = 'response'
  ))
```


```{r}
mean((shots_2025$xfg_model3 - shots_2025$made)^2)
```

```{r}
shots_2025_model2_model3 <- shots_2025 |> 
  group_by(under_3s) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    fg_percentage = mean(made),
    breir_model2 = mean((xfg_model2 - made)^2),
    breir_model3 = mean((xfg_model3 - made)^2),
    avg_xfg_model2 = mean(xfg_model2),
    avg_xfg_model3 = mean(xfg_model3)
  )
```

## Model 6

```{r}
model_6 <- glm(
  made ~ splines::ns(shot_distance, df = 4) +
    sub_type +
    under_3s +
    shot_angle +
    at_origin,
  data = shots_2024,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_6)
```

```{r}
shots_2025 <- shots_2025 |> 
  mutate(xfg_model6 = predict(
         object = model_6,
         newdata = shots_2025,
         type = 'response'))
```


```{r}
mean((shots_2025$xfg_model6 - shots_2025$made)^2)
```

```{r}
         time_remaining = minutes * 60 + seconds,
         under_3s = if_else(time_remaining <= 3, 1, 0),
```

### Shot Selection Quality

```{r}
shots_2026_player_table <- shots_2026 |> 
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    Total_xPts = sum(xPts),
    SSQ = Total_xPts/attempts
  )
```
## Shot Making Performance

```{r}
shots_2026_player_table <- shots_2026 |> 
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    actual_points = sum(actual_pts),
    Total_xPts = sum(xPts),
    SSQ = Total_xPts/attempts,
    SMP = (actual_points - Total_xPts)/attempts
  )
```

### Points Above Expected

```{r}
shots_2026_player_table <- shots_2026 |> 
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |> 
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    actual_points = sum(actual_pts),
    Total_xPts = sum(xPts),
    SSQ = Total_xPts/attempts,
    SMP = (actual_points - Total_xPts)/attempts,
    PAE = round(actual_points - Total_xPts, 2)
  )
```

## Filter players by 300 FGA
```{r}
shots_2026_qualified <- shots_2026_player_table |> 
  filter(attempts > 299)
```


## Quadrant Plot

```{r}
league_avg_SSQ <- mean(shots_2026$xPts)
```

```{r}

# League average SSQ for qualified players
league_avg_SSQ <- mean(shots_2026_qualified$SSQ, na.rm = TRUE)

# Players to highlight
featured_players <- shots_2026_qualified |>
  filter(
    person_id %in% c(
      2544,     # LeBron James
      201142,   # Kevin Durant
      201939,   # Stephen Curry
      201942,   # DeMar DeRozan
      1627751,  # Jakob Poeltl
      203497    # Rudy Gobert
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    display_name = case_when(
      person_id == 2544 ~ "LeBron James",
      person_id == 201142 ~ "Kevin Durant",
      person_id == 201939 ~ "Stephen Curry",
      person_id == 201942 ~ "DeMar DeRozan",
      person_id == 1627751 ~ "Jakob Poeltl",
      person_id == 203497 ~ "Rudy Gobert"
    )
  )

# Colors
bg <- "#101827"
panel <- "#172235"
white <- "#F8FAFC"
muted <- "#A8B8CF"
highlight_color <- "#38BDF8"

nba_quadrant_plot <- ggplot(
  shots_2026_qualified,
  aes(x = SSQ, y = SMP)
) +

  # background points
  geom_point(
    color = "#94A3B8",
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.8
  ) +

  # reference lines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "#CBD5E1",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = league_avg_SSQ,
    color = "#CBD5E1",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # highlighted points
  geom_point(
    data = featured_players,
    color = highlight_color,
    size = 4
  ) +

  # highlighted labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = featured_players,
    aes(label = display_name),
    color = white,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    force = 3,
    force_pull = 0.6,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 42,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "#94A3B8",
    segment.alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "GOOD SHOT, BAD SHOT?",
    subtitle = "NBA 2025–26 | Shot Selection vs. Shot-Making Performance",
    x = "SHOT SELECTION QUALITY (Expected Points per Attempt)",
    y = "SHOT-MAKING PERFORMANCE (SMP)",
    caption = "300+ FGA | Heave-adjusted sample | Dashed lines represent league averages"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = panel, color = NA),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#344155", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      color = white,
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 4)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      color = muted,
      size = 8.5,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = muted,
      size = 8,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      color = white,
      face = "bold",
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      color = white,
      face = "bold",
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = white,
      size = 8.5
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 18, b = 12, l = 18)
  )

nba_quadrant_plot

ggsave(
  "Good_Shot_Bad_Shot_2026.png",
  plot = nba_quadrant_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = bg
)
```

```{r}


shots_2026_court_filtered <- shots_2026_court_bins |>
  filter(
    attemtps >= 30,
    !is.na(avg_xPts)
  )

# Colour palette
bg <- "#101827"
hardwood <- "#D5AD72"
hardwood_light <- "#E5C390"
court_lines <- "#FFFFFF"
white <- "#FFFFFF"
muted <- "#CBD5E1"

nba_heatmap <- geom_basketball(
  league = "NBA",
  display_range = "offense",
  rotation = 270,
  color_updates = list(
    plot_background = bg,
    offensive_half_court = hardwood,
    defensive_half_court = hardwood,
    court_apron = bg,
    two_point_range = c(hardwood, "#FFFFFF00"),
    painted_area = c(hardwood_light, "#FFFFFF00"),
    center_circle_fill = hardwood,
    free_throw_circle_fill = hardwood,
    sideline = court_lines,
    endline = court_lines,
    division_line = court_lines,
    center_circle_outline = court_lines,
    three_point_line = court_lines,
    lane_boundary = court_lines,
    free_throw_circle_outline = court_lines,
    free_throw_circle_dash = court_lines,
    lane_space_mark = court_lines,
    restricted_arc = court_lines,
    backboard = court_lines,
    basket_ring = "#F97316"
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    data = shots_2026_court_filtered,
    aes(
      x = court_x,
      y = court_y,
      fill = avg_xPts
    ),
    width = 2.5,
    height = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#BBDCF9",
      "#76B5E8",
      "#3682BC",
      "#155184",
      "#071D40"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(
      c(0.65, 0.85, 1.05, 1.25, 1.50)
    ),
    limits = c(0.65, 1.50),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = c(0.75, 1.00, 1.25, 1.50),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    name = "EXPECTED POINTS\nPER ATTEMPT",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      blegend.title = element_text(
      colour = white,
      size = 9,
      face = "bold",
      lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
),
      frame.colour = NA,
      ticks.colour = white,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0
    )
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(-25, 25),
    ylim = c(-47, -1),
    ratio = 1,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "WHERE ARE THE NBA'S MOST VALUABLE SHOTS?",
    subtitle = "GOOD SHOT, BAD SHOT?  |  NBA 2025–26",
    caption = paste(
      "Model 6 expected points  •  2.5-ft bins  •",
      "30+ attempts per bin  •  Heave-adjusted"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = bg,
      colour = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = hardwood,
      colour = NA
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      colour = white,
      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      margin = margin(b = 3)
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      colour = "#38BDF8",
      face = "bold",
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      colour = muted,
      size = 7.5,
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(
      colour = white,
      size = 9,
      face = "bold",
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(

    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(

    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(

    ),

    legend.margin = margin(l = 4),

    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 5
    )
  )

nba_heatmap

)
```

```{r}
  mutate(demar_distance_summary, player = "Demar"),
)

comparison_NBA_demar <- comparison_NBA_demar |>
  group_by(player) |>
  mutate(
    shot_share = round(attempts / sum(attempts) * 100, 2)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
ggplot(comparison_NBA_demar, aes(x = distance_bin, y = SMP, fill = player)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Demar vs NBA Shot-Making Performance",
    x = "Shot Distance",
    y = "SMP"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(comparison_NBA_demar, aes(x = distance_bin, y = shot_share, fill = player)) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge')

ggplot(demar_distance_summary, aes(x = distance_bin, y = PAE)) +
  geom_col()
```
## Rudy Gobert

```{r}
gobert <- shots_2026 |> 
 mutate(
    distance_bin = cut(
      shot_distance,
      breaks = c(-1, 4, 9, 14, 22, 29, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "At Rim",
        "Short Range",
        "Midrange",
        "Long Midrange",
        "Three-Point Range",
        "Deep"
      )
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(person_id == 203497)
```

```{r}
gobert_distance_summary <- gobert|>
  group_by(distance_bin) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    SSQ = mean(xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_PPA = mean(actual_pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    SMP = actual_PPA - SSQ,
    PAE = sum(actual_pts - xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
comparison_NBA_gobert <- bind_rows(

  ungroup()
```


### Player Comparison

```{r}
player_comparison_2026 <- shots_2026 |>
  filter(
    person_id %in% c(
      201142,    # Durant
      201939,    # Curry
      2544,      # LeBron
      201942,    # DeRozan
      203497,    # Gobert
      1627751    # Poeltl
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(person_id, player_name) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    SSQ = mean(xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_PPA = mean(actual_pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    SMP = actual_PPA - SSQ,
    PAE = sum(actual_pts - xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(PAE))

player_comparison_2026
```


## All 6 players
```{r}
player_distance_comparison <- shots_2026 |>
  filter(person_id %in% c(
    201142, 201942,   # Durant, DeRozan
    203497, 1627751, # Gobert, Poeltl
    201939, 2544     # Curry, LeBron
  )) |>
  mutate(
    distance_bin = cut(
      shot_distance,
      breaks = c(-1, 4, 9, 14, 22, 29, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "At Rim",
        "Short Range",
        "Midrange",
        "Long Midrange",
        "Three-Point Range",
        "Deep"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(person_id, player_name, distance_bin) |>
  summarise(
    attempts = n(),
    SSQ = mean(xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_PPA = mean(actual_pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    SMP = actual_PPA - SSQ,
    PAE = sum(actual_pts - xPts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(person_id) |>
  mutate(
    shot_share = round(attempts / sum(attempts) * 100, 2)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

player_distance_comparison

```
